messages.author: 7a97c986864bf6d6
messages.subject: Skewed student t distribution
parts:
Hello Stan developers,

I have found that the creation of a skewed student t distribution was added to the Github issues and closed (https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1485), but I can't find it's implementation in the manual.

Is this prior available?

Thanks.
Stefano

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Skewed student t distribution
parts:
No, it hasn't been added, but you'll see that the issue
was moved from stan-dev/stan to stan-dev/math as it has
to go in the math library first:

https://github.com/stan-dev/math/issues/100

- Bob
